Colours of the actor types in htna plots

Source: R/plot_htna.R
htna_palette.Rd

htna_palette gives the default fill colours of the actor types in the network plots of htna: the first actor type takes the first colour, the second the second, and so on. With more than six actor types the colours are recycled with a warning, so pass a longer vector to group_colors in that case. Each plot also gives the actor types different node shapes, so the actor types are not distinguished by colour alone.

Usage

htna_palette

Format

A character vector of six hexadecimal colours.

Value

A character vector of six hexadecimal colours.

See also

plot_htna(), plot_htna_diff(), plot_htna_bootstrap()

Examples

htna_palette
#> [1] "#FFD966" "#B4A7D6" "#93C47D" "#E06666" "#6FA8DC" "#F6B26B"
